lines.cherokee_syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎯ ᏥᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᏛᏉ ᏂᎦᏥᏪᏎᎭ-ᎢᏥᏯᏫᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
lines.text: Na-s-gi-no hi-a ni-hi tsi-ni-tsv-we-se-ha, na-s-gi ni-ga-dv-quo ni-ga-tsi-we-se-ha--I-tsi-ya-wi-s-ge-s-di.
lines.english: And what I say unto you I say unto all, Watch.
lines.emitted_text: nvhskinho hi'a nihitsinvtslvweheha nahski nikatakwu nikatsiwehseha v itsiyo'hskehsti
